# P02 frozen design fixtures

These files pin the intended `island/mujoco-sim@0.1.1` scene/device catalog before implementation. `target-descriptor.json` is the additive `backend-v2.json` schema-`2.0.0` target with exact `catalog_version:"0.1.0"`; its scene hashes match the two repository XML files at design review. `legacy-descriptor.json` has neither discriminator nor any target metadata. Any partial mix must fail. `expected-contribution.json` records the new process type and seven type IDs in the `0.1.0` `sim-hardware` template. It is an expected projection, not a current release payload. `negative-cases.json` records JSON Pointer mutations and machine-checkable `{code,path,stage}` results for direct package verification and graph semantic admission, plus the revision boundary; implementation tests should use these cases or equivalent assertions. A descriptor mutation applied after a sealed P01 receipt first yields `package_changed` rather than its P02 semantic code; test P02 descriptor cases before sealing or against a verified-handle semantic unit fixture.

P01 verifies the exact receipt, payload tree, sidecar and safe paths first. P02 may derive options only from that verified handle. P03 defines the generic node-options response. R05 later validates device IDs and commands on the private socket. No fixture grants actuator authority or changes legacy graph bytes.
